✨ Welcome to the KATSEYE <BEAUTIFUL CHAOS> tour roleplay game! Here, you can dive into the action and participate however you like—whether as a member, DJ, fan, or dancer.

🎤 Want to stay updated on developments, shows, and announcements?
Check out our Roblox group for all the latest news and upcoming events.

📌 Developed by Ángel, Eazy, Evan, and Louis.
Please note that this game is still under active development and will receive frequent updates.
All credits to HYBE and Geffen Records.

If you have any suggestions, feel free to share them on our group forum!
